scope: Post-hoc concrete contract counterexamples; no production data or PostgreSQL integration instance used. Does not expand the 13 oracle items.

integer_narrowing.trigger: A source revision valid for SQLite/JS safe-integer semantics exceeds int4. This is a permitted-input witness, not observed production data.

absent_key_import_trace: Transactions A/B both lookup external key K: absent.
A/B both SELECT FOR UPDATE WHERE external_key=K: no retrieved row to row-lock.
A inserts K revision1 and commits.
B attempts INSERT K and receives unique violation.
Without absent-key serialization/re-read logic, the proposed plain create Error maps to500 instead of the serialized upsert-import stale-revision409.
backup_asset_trace: Dump snapshot contains asset row R referencing file F.
After that snapshot, a live delete removes F and then its metadata.
The later filesystem copy omits F; per-file checksums of copied files can still pass.
Restoring the dump restores R but no F; mutation exclusion or equivalent snapshot retention is required.
